pr_base_determination.method: Enumerated every origin head, tested each with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, and ranked the ancestors by `git rev-list --count <base>..HEAD`.
pr_base_determination.reason: It is the nearest ancestor that actually exists on origin. The suggested base was never published, and the mission forbids pushing any branch other than the repair branch, so it cannot be created.
pr_base_determination.consequence: The draft PR spans 53 commits: the unpublished M328-M343 work plus this closure's 19. It is NOT a 19-commit diff. This is stated in the PR body so no reviewer mistakes the scope.
pr_base_determination.recommended_follow_up: If a narrower PR is wanted, publish milestone/m336-m343-private-alpha-readiness first and retarget the base. That requires separate authorization to push another branch.
